snippets: Physical Intelligence's pi0.5 base checkpoint (pi05_base, openpi) behind the arena_planners bridge, as a zero-shot navigation baseline. It drives the robot through the two action dims that command a mobile manipulator's base, [v, omega], from the front camera and a text instruction, the way VEGA (arXiv 2606.18426, sec.
OPENPI_DATA_HOME of the server. ... Server port on 127.0.0.1, 0 picks a free one. ... Time allowed for the server to load the checkpoint.

robot.planner:=pi05 selects robot.mobile:=vla. The planner accepts the instruction only (goal_inputs: [instruction]), the goal pose never reaches it and decides success alone. It has no stop head and sends no signals, Arena judges arrival. openpi's pi05_aloha inference config (openpi's own default serve_policy.py --env ALOHA, which also serves pi05_base) with two changes in server/serve.py: the Mobile ALOHA norm stats (trossen_mobile) instead of the static ALOHA ones, and an output transform that keeps the 16 action dims of that embodiment instead of the 14 arm dims (AlohaOutputs drops the base).

weights.yaml fetches the 12.4 GB gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi05_base (params plus the trossen_mobile and arx_mobile norm stats) and the PaliGemma tokenizer from gs://big_vision. The pi0.5 weights derive from PaliGemma and are subject to the Gemma Terms of Use, see openpi's LICENSE_GEMMA.txt.

import safetensors.torch from openpi.models.pi0_config import Pi0Config from openpi.models_pytorch.pi0_pytorch import PI0Pytorch model = PI0Pytorch(Pi0Config(pi05=True, action_horizon=50, action_dim=32)) safetensors.torch.load_model(model, "model.safetensors", strict=True) Verify the download with sha256sum model.safetensors against the hash above.
